response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS total FROM income WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_member), s AS (SELECT total, total * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(total) FROM t) AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.total) AS combined_amount, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share

assumptions.assumption: The 'average share' used as the threshold is the mean of the per-member shares across all members with income (equal to 1 divided by the member count). The reported 'average share' is the mean share among only the above-threshold members.
Income rows with a NULL link_to_member are excluded, so they are not treated as a member and do not count toward the sum of all totals.
Shares are computed with real (non-integer) division and nothing is rounded.
